import os
import sqlite3
import requests
COMMENTS_DATABASE_PATH = '/srv/blog/data/comments.db'
AKISMET_API_KEY = os.environ.get('AKISMET_API_KEY', '')
BLOG_HOME_URL = 'https://blog.example.com'

def remove_spam_comment_and_report(comment_id: int) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(COMMENTS_DATABASE_PATH)
    database_connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    spam_comment_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT id, author_name, author_ip, user_agent, body FROM comments WHERE id = ?', (comment_id,)).fetchone()
    if spam_comment_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return {'deleted': False, 'error': f'Comment {comment_id} not found'}
    akismet_report_response = requests.post(f'https://{AKISMET_API_KEY}.rest.akismet.com/1.1/submit-spam', data={'blog': BLOG_HOME_URL, 'user_ip': spam_comment_row['author_ip'], 'user_agent': spam_comment_row['user_agent'], 'comment_author': spam_comment_row['author_name'], 'comment_content': spam_comment_row['body'], 'comment_type': 'comment'}, timeout=10)
    akismet_report_response.raise_for_status()
    database_connection.execute('DELETE FROM comments WHERE id = ?', (comment_id,))
    # Revoke commenting permission for the spammer's IP address
    database_connection.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS commenter_permissions (author_ip TEXT PRIMARY KEY, can_comment INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)')
    database_connection.execute('INSERT INTO commenter_permissions (author_ip, can_comment) VALUES (?, 0) ON CONFLICT(author_ip) DO UPDATE SET can_comment = 0', (spam_comment_row['author_ip'],))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return {'deleted': True, 'comment_id': comment_id, 'reported_to_akismet': True, 'commenting_revoked_for_ip': spam_comment_row['author_ip']}
